# Exact current authored corpus

These 130 declared module files preserve every byte from the published flat-main revisions in source-provenance.json: Psyche75, Mind39, Field16. No module descriptions or bodies were simplified. Each typed snapshot differs from its named main solely in modules.datom; every other tracked blob is identical. Both manifests are retained. The typed manifests preserve the flat declarations in the same order, replacing the version list with Single.

module-oracle.tsv is an independent expected identity/path/source SHA-256/decoded description table. module-oracle.json retains original Git blobs. The corpus has127 plain descriptions and3 double-quoted descriptions. The original quoted main-flow, git-server and nix-builds descriptions remain present. This fixture proves the typed-manifest adapter over the exact actual authored corpus; the typed producer intentionally refuses literal flat manifests. It does not claim literal current-main manifest compatibility.
